notes:
CIRCUIT: a two-rail ladder. Top rail y~400 runs from the top-left corner (150,400) to the top-right corner (880,400) and carries the 90mH inductor (#1) and then the 10sint V AC source (#0). Bottom rail y~628 runs the full width. Four shunt branches drop between the rails: 20sint V AC (#3) at x~140, 91uF cap (#2) at x~327, 5ohm resistor (#4) at x~630, 31cost A AC current source (#5) at x~880. A GND stem hangs off the bottom rail at x~499. The rectangle around the sheet is the page border, not wire.

NET MAP (4 nets):
n3 = top-rail left section: 20sint V-AC top lead (137,459) up to the top-left corner, right through S7 (318,407) where the 91uF's top lead T's on, to the 90mH left lead (392,399). Terminals 3.0, 2.0, 1.0.
n1 = top rail from the 90mH right lead (524,407) through S6 (619,402) where the 5ohm's top lead T's on, to the 10sint V-AC left lead (702,398). Terminals 1.1, 4.0, 0.0.
n2 = 10sint V-AC right lead (800,395) to the top-right corner (~880,400) and down to the 31cost A top lead (868,483). Terminals 0.1, 5.0.
0  = the entire bottom rail: 20sint V-AC bottom (145,539) down to the bottom-left corner (150,630), right through S13 (326,629, 91uF bottom), S14 (499,626, GND stem), S12 (633,626, 5ohm bottom) to the bottom-right corner and up to the 31cost A bottom lead (883,588). Terminals 3.1, 2.1, 6.0, 4.1, 5.1.

JUDGEMENT CALLS: none are genuinely ambiguous - this sheet has no crossing anywhere, no solder dot and no hop or jog. All five CRITICAL sites are plain T's (one wire ending on another), where junction is the only possible reading, and all five are recorded explicitly as JUNCTION:
S7 (318,407) - 91uF top lead T's onto the top rail. Crossing/none would strand the cap's top on a 1-terminal net and split the left top rail.
S6 (619,402) - 5ohm top lead T's onto the top rail. Same consequence for the resistor's top.
S13 (326,629) - 91uF bottom lead T's onto the bottom rail.
S12 (633,626) - 5ohm bottom lead T's onto the bottom rail.
S14 (499,626) - GND stem T's onto the bottom rail (the tracer calls it deg 4 because the ground symbol's top bar is picked up as a branch). Any other reading would leave the whole circuit with no ground reference and put GND on a net of its own.
Dot metrics are 1.1-1.6 throughout, i.e. the drafter drew no solder dots at all; that is consistent, since every connection here is a T where a dot is unnecessary.

PORTS: no fixes needed - all seven components already point at real leads. The stray port candidates are label ink: p2 on #0 is the '10' of '10 sint V', p3/p4/p5 on #1 are the '90mH' caption, p2 on #4 is the '5ohm' caption, p2/p3 on #5 are the 'A' of '31cost A'. Non-critical text-touch sites S2/S3/S4 ('90mH'), S8 ('91uF') and S9/S10 ('5ohm') left at default; none of them reaches a second component terminal.
CLASSES: all 7 agree with the labels. #0 and #3 are circles with a tilde labelled '10 sint V' and '20 sint V' (V-AC); #5 is a circle with a tilde AND a down arrow labelled '31cost A' (I-AC, not V-AC); #1 coil, #2 two-plate cap, #4 zig-zag resistor, #6 GND. No re-classification.
UNRESOLVED: none.
